title: Annotating the Chain-of-Thought: A Behavior-Labeled Dataset for AI Safety
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith/religion. Its focus is on general AI safety behaviors during chain-of-thought reasoning in response to harmful prompts.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
